activity_summary: You paid twenty shillings before noon and counted them twice. Mistress Ansell wrote the receipt in her late husband's law-hand. She said the quarter's candles had come to more than the quarter's bread, and that she had never before had a lodger of whom that was true. You did not argue it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the twenty shillings twice and took the receipt.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Wrote the receipt, and said the candles had outrun the bread.

facets.activity: Paid twenty shillings and counted them twice

quotes.text: Twenty shillings on the board. Count them, and then count them again.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The candles this quarter came to more than the quarter's bread.
